narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Sticks are far too slow. Letters are the best way, because they are so quick to say.
<bookmark mark='z'/>Count along the letters all the way to zed, and ask what comes next.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>There is no letter after zed, so letters stop at twenty six cows and fail the first test.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows letters are best, so quick; the letters a to z run along a line and stop at z with an empty box after it; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>A good way to count must never end and must stay quick for big numbers.
<bookmark mark='name'/>A way of writing every number with a few symbols and a rule is called a number system.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Kavya counts using the seven names of the days of the week. Put her way through both tests.
